label: TAL_plasma_control
comments: Blood samples were drawn on day 1 and 6 (in the increased_renal_impairment who needed dialysis on days 1 only) before and at 10, 20, 30, 45 min and 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3, 3.5, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 12, 24 h after ingestion of 100 mg talinolol. Additional samples were drawn 36 h (control volunteers) and 48 h (increased_renal_impairments with renal impairment) after talinolol intake on day 6 or 48 h after talinolol ingestion on day 1 in increased_renal_impairments with terminal renal insufficiency.
